$comment: The scenery's stand records, as the sprite map writes them and the stands frame carries them: eight bytes a stand, little-endian. Two bytes across and two down, in eighths of a world unit from the north-west corner of the zoom 7 tile the records belong to, and running past it, because a stand is written into every tile it touches; then the reach in quarters of a unit, the favourite kind, the thickness in four-hundredths of a point to the square unit, and a seed. Generated by encodeStands in frontend/packages/world/src/stands.ts. The Kotlin protocol test reads the middles and the reaches out of the records, the world package's test decodes the whole of them, and both must agree with what is listed here. The first stands in the tile above, the last left of the tile and below it, and the middle one reaches as far as a byte allows.
